translate_en|mods/ExoticDancerProfession: %1 lifts the mood with a practiced routine.
Exotic Dancer runtime features are disabled by the server.
Closing time came early. You begin at %1.
Starting costume changes are restricted to admins/debug mode.
Your one starting-costume change has already been used.
Debug/admin: right-click the ground and use Exotic Dancer > Change Starting Costume to preview another look.
Perform a known dance as full-body exercise. Builds Strength and Fitness and may cause muscle fatigue in the arms, chest, and legs.
A little cash lifts your spirits.
Only survivors with Stage Presence can perform this routine.
The routine lands. You feel a little lighter.
Stage Presence is still recovering: %1 in-game hours remaining.
You are too exhausted to keep dancing.
You need more time and endurance before dancing again.
Polearm Pun is enabled: Spear starts at level 1.
True Actions Dancing detected. Compatible dance emotes will be attempted when available.
Lets each new Exotic Dancer replace the assigned costume once through the right-click menu.
Flat boredom points removed from each eligible audience member.
Maximum same-floor distance at which survivors can receive audience benefits.
Percentage of the full stress range removed from each eligible audience member.
Flat unhappiness points removed from each eligible audience member.
Performer benefit cooldown in in-game hours when cooldown is enabled. Default: 0 (no cooldown). Live admin changes apply to the next routine request. Maximum: 720 hours.

When enabled, Exotic Dancer performances use the same Strength, Fitness, regularity, endurance, and muscle-strain mechanics as Burpees and appear in the Exercise menu. Disable this to keep dance morale benefits and the normal performance endurance cost without exercise progression.
Per eligible club or bar container chance to receive a Detached Stage Pole when first generated.
Allows nearby survivors to receive a smaller morale benefit.
Adds all Bunny, Revue, Cowboy, and Glam stagewear pieces to the Exotic Dancer clothing dropdowns.
Optional. Prevents repeated performance benefits until the configured cooldown expires. Disabled by default.
Allows the custom two-handed stage pole weapon to appear rarely in club, bar, dressing-room, and backstage containers.
Continuously drains endurance on server-authoritative in-game-minute ticks while the survivor performs.
Adds Witch, Nurse, Bride / Groom, and Mummy to the starting-costume choices and to the Random pool. OFF by default.
Shows reward amounts and explains when money remains unchecked because of cooldown, mood, or the reward cap.
Newly acquired money can reduce boredom and unhappiness for Exotic Dancers. Money is checked only after a successful benefit; rewarded bundles pass that checked state to their unbundled cash.
Allows the exercise-based Sultry Workout visual and related admin/debug routines without awarding exercise XP or repetitions.
Shows initialization, cooldown, costume, performance, and reward feedback through halo text.
Enables the continuous dance controller. Dances continue until interrupted, stopped, or exhausted and do not display a timed-action progress bar.
Cycles through a built-in dance visual sequence while the performance remains active.
Performance noise is generated at the start and during eligible periodic Stage Presence ticks.
Applies performer and audience morale benefits periodically while a valid performance remains active.
New Exotic Dancers start at Spear level 1. No free weapon is granted. This toggle does not alter the configured profession point cost.
Master switch. Turn this OFF for a bare-bones occupation with only static profession bonuses and an inert Stage Presence trait.
Allows a successful routine to reduce the performer's boredom, unhappiness, and stress.
Enables all gameplay effects associated with Stage Presence.
Stores dance IDs on new Exotic Dancers for compatibility with the dance selection system.
New Exotic Dancers receive a clean random or configured vanilla stage costume when no stagewear was selected during character creation.
Soft compatibility only. The profession works without True Actions Dancing and never declares it as a dependency.
Percentage of maximum endurance removed after a completed routine.
Server-authoritative percentage of endurance removed per in-game minute while performing.
Money Boredom Reduction per Reward Unit
Boredom removed per money reward unit. Loose cash is one unit; rolls and bundles use diminishing returns.
Minutes between successful money bonuses. Set to 0 to disable the cooldown. Default: 60.

Maximum reward units applied in one payout. Default: 5, limiting each default payout to 10 unhappiness and 5 boredom. With cooldown disabled, extra fresh money stays queued for later capped payouts; with a cooldown, overflow remains unchecked for a later pickup.
Money Unhappiness Reduction per Reward Unit
Unhappiness removed per money reward unit. Loose cash is one unit; rolls and bundles use diminishing returns.
World-sound radius generated by a completed routine.
World-sound volume generated by a completed routine.

Random chooses one of the four standard presets, or all eight presets when Halloween Starting Costume is enabled. Character-creation stagewear is respected as a custom outfit. Unrestricted keeps all vanilla and modded character-creation clothing and also adds the stagewear choices without forcing a preset. Live admin changes apply to future new characters.
Real-time duration at normal game speed before a routine completes.
The performance stops automatically when endurance reaches this percentage or lower.
Sets the Exotic Dancer point cost. Positive values cost points; negative values grant points. Default: 6.
Audience members must be able to see the performer to receive benefits.
Flat boredom points removed from the performer.
Percentage of the full stress range removed from the performer.
Flat unhappiness points removed from the performer.
Number of dance IDs stored when a new Exotic Dancer is initialized.
A heavy detachable club pole. Awkward, exhausting, and excellent at knocking things down.
Skilled at moving with balance and control, with improved fitness and strength.
Skilled at moving with balance and control, with improved fitness and strength.

Can perform routines that relieve boredom, unhappiness and stress for the performer and nearby survivors.
Performances consume endurance, make noise and have a cooldown.
